# Stage 2J fixtures — SYNTHETIC — NOT REAL COST DATA

Produced by the **Stage 2J** code (commit `b547b6a`) and kept unchanged, so that later stages can prove
they still read older data:

- `SYNTHETIC_DRAFTS.xlsx` — the synthetic BQ used by the draft-row tests (artificial descriptions, dummy figures).
- `SYNTHETIC_DRAFTS.review-backup.json` — a review backup of it with every verified proposal approved and
  synthetic project details entered. It has no draft-row decisions, because Stage 2J did not have them.

Do not edit these files: they stand for data users already have.
